note: Mechanical repairs applied to compiler output so a package can ship before upstream fixes the emitter. A repair may only correct TEXT. It may never change absence, reference identity, equality, ordering, exception shape, or task settlement -- those are the contract in AGENTS.md, and a semantic repair is a lie that our own tests would then certify. Every repair declares the upstream defect it stands in for, and `npm run sdk:check` fails when a repair stops matching anything, so a repair cannot outlive the bug it answers. Two kinds exist. A declared `insert-forward-declaration` entry below names a symbol the emitter omits. The duplicate-structural-struct aliasing in scripts/emissionRepairs.mjs needs no entry because it is derived entirely from the emitted tree: it finds an anonymous structural struct defined in more than one package namespace with BYTE-IDENTICAL bodies, keeps the flight::types definition, and turns every other copy into a type alias to it. It reports what it aliased in manifest.duplicateStructuralStructAliases, and it is self-expiring -- when the emitter stops duplicating these, it finds nothing and rewrites nothing.

repairs.declaration: namespace flight::types { template <typename Traits> struct Node; }
repairs.defect: The emitter's forward-declaration collector walks the names a module references directly, but misses names it reaches only by expanding another package's type alias. flight::types::Node2D expands to flight::StructuralRef<flight::RowMerge<flight::RowOf<flight::Ref<flight::types::Node<flight::Ref<Node2DTraits>>>>, ...>>, so a header using the Node2D alias names Node without ever declaring it.
repairs.expires: when the forward-declaration collector follows alias expansion; sdk:check fails if this repair matches no file.

repairs.defect: Same collector defect as types-node-forward-declaration, reached through the render-options aliases.
repairs.expires: when the forward-declaration collector follows alias expansion; sdk:check fails if this repair matches no header in a profiled run. RenderCache is only reachable once external bindings let @flighthq/render emit, so the unbound inventory is not evidence that this repair is unneeded.

repairs.diagnostic: 'LogEntry' was not declared in this scope; did you mean 'flight::types::LogEntry'?
repairs.defect: The emitter writes LogEntry unqualified inside namespace flight::log, where the type is flight::types::LogEntry. It is a type alias, so no forward declaration exists for it, and the defining header is already included -- only the qualification is missing. gcc names the fix in its own diagnostic.
repairs.expires: when the emitter qualifies a types-owned name used from another package's namespace; sdk:check fails if this repair matches no header.
